message.reasoning: The user wants to convert 10 dollars to euros and then make a deposit of 10 dollars into their local bank account with account number 987654. The user says "make a 10 dollar deposit" but they also want conversion. They might want to convert 10 dollars to euros first? Actually they say "convert 10 dollars to Euros and make a 10 dollar deposit". That implies they want to convert 10 USD to EUR, then deposit 10 USD? Or deposit the converted amount? The phrase "make a 10 dollar deposit" suggests deposit 10 USD. But maybe they want to deposit the converted amount? The user didn't specify deposit after conversion or deposit the original amount. The user said "convert 10 dollars to Euros and make a 10 dollar deposit in my local bank account with account number - 987654." So we should interpret as: convert 10 USD to EUR (maybe to know how many euros), then deposit 10 USD into account 987654. We can do two separate calls: first call currency_conversion with amount=10, from_currency="USD", to_currency="EUR". Then call banking_service with account_id="987654", amount=10. We'll do them sequentially.
